id: -518-阿契美尼德王朝征服印度河流域
theater: 信德河上游與傑赫勒姆河兩岸

battle.name: 阿契美尼德王朝征服印度河流域
battle.theater: 信德河上游與傑赫勒姆河兩岸
battle.brief: 公元前五一八年，阿契美尼德王朝的達里烏斯一世把帝國東界推過印度河，在信德河與傑赫勒姆河擊敗健馱羅與薩塔吉達。貝希斯敦銘文只留下渡河擊敗印度人、把疆界立在印度河畔數語；希羅多德另記河上架舟為浮橋、薩塔吉達僅失一城。亞述長矛那種短柄長刃鐵矛，正是護盾兵的制式兵器。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 交戰的一方是阿契美尼德帝國，國王達里烏斯一世御駕。帝國的軍隊並非單一民族，而是由各行省按編制湊成的混合部隊：骨幹是萬人的護盾兵大隊（後世稱不死軍），成員多為波斯與米底的老兵，裝備柳條圓盾、短矛、弓、箭袋與短彎刀；其餘有巴克特里亞人、帕提亞人、索格底亞人、薩迦人、健馱羅人、印度人等行省部隊，另有車隊、象兵與工匠隨營行進。指揮系統是國王、行省總督、軍團三層：國王身邊有侍從長、紀錄官與御前騎士團，命令沿御道驛站逐站接力傳遞。另一方是印度河流域北部的諸地方政權與部族聯盟：健馱羅（都城普什卡拉瓦蒂，約今白沙瓦一帶）、薩塔吉達（確切位置未定，學者多放在阿拉科西亞與印度河中游之間），以及希羅多德提到的達迪卡人與阿帕里塔人；他們各有城牆、村落與弓手，並非統一國家，而是地方首領糾合的武裝集團。帝國沒有把這些地方併入本土，而是劃成健馱羅、薩塔吉達、興都什三個行省，向中央繳納固定貢賦，並在印度河與傑赫勒姆河一線留下駐軍。
countriesEn: One side was the Achaemenid Empire, led in person by the king Darius I. The imperial army was not a single people but a mixed force raised according to the quotas of the satrapies. Its backbone was the ten thousand strong corps of shield-bearers, later called the Immortals, whose ranks were largely old soldiers of Persian and Median origin and who carried wicker round shields, a short spear, a bow, a quiver and a short sword. Alongside them marched the contingents of Bactria, Parthia, Sogdia, the Saka, the Gandharans and the Indians, together with the chariot corps, war elephants and the craftsmen who travelled with the baggage. The command structure ran in three tiers, the king, the satraps and the generals: the king had beside him a chamberlain, a scribe and the royal cavalry, while orders travelled by relay down the stations of the Royal Road. The other side was made up of the local polities and tribal confederations of the upper Indus: Gandhara, whose capital was Pushkalavati in the region of present-day Peshawar, and Sattagydia, whose position is uncertain and which most scholars place between Arachosia and the middle Indus, together with the Dadicae and the Aparytae named by Herodotus. Each had its own walls, its own villages and its own archers, and none of them was a unified state; they were armed groups gathered around local chiefs. The empire did not absorb these territories into the metropolitan core. It marked them out as three provinces, Gandhara, Sattagydia and Hindush, assessed them for fixed tribute, and left a garrison on the line of the Indus and the Jhelum.
people: 可以指名的有四類。第一類是帝王與血親：達里烏斯一世在位於前五二二年至前四八六年，登基頭幾年先平定冒充巴比倫王的祭司高米達、薩迦人的反叛與巴比倫的暴動，才把注意力轉向東方；他的弟弟岡比西斯彼時正在埃及，聽到斯美爾迪斯仍活著的傳言與兄長遇刺的消息，幾乎起兵，靠母親阿托莎與信使往返才被勸住。帝國東邊的對手在貝希斯敦銘文裡有名字：文中提到那拉姆辛這個印度人起兵反叛，後世希臘作家稱此人為恩基杜，多數學者認為他就是健馱羅地區的君主，與銘文所列的健馱羅行省恰好對應。第二類是留下文字的人：希羅多德在《歷史》第三卷第九十二至一百零二節補述印度河遠征，提到薩塔吉達人與印度人的戰鬥、只有一座城市被攻下；同書又記達里烏斯另外派希臘航海者斯庫拉克斯率偵察隊沿印度河順流而下，走了三十個月後經紅海回到埃及，他的《周航記》只剩片段。留下手藝痕跡的還有工匠：貝希斯敦浮雕上，國王左手持弓、右手舉起，一名侍從替他執矛，腳下是九名被縛的首領；波斯波利斯阿帕達納台階上的印度貢使浮雕則是另一批工匠所為。第三類是留在原地的守軍與軍官：印度河畔那座印度城的駐軍指揮官、健馱羅的本地首領，以及健馱羅、薩塔吉達、達迪卡與阿帕里塔的村社頭目。第四類是後世的記述者：克諾索斯的克泰西亞斯說波斯王收到印度諸王的厚禮，並記印度象與象夫在宮廷上示強；斯特拉波在《地理學》第十五卷描述印度河沿岸各族的分佈。
peopleEn: Four kinds of people can be named. The first are the king and his blood: Darius I reigned from 522 to 486 BC, and in the first years of his reign he had to put down the magus Gaumata, who impersonated the king of Babylon, the revolt of the Saka and the rising in Babylonia, before he could turn his attention eastwards. His brother Cambyses was in Egypt at the time, and when he heard the rumour that Smerdis was still alive and that his brother had been murdered he came close to rising himself, and was talked back down only by his mother Atossa and by messengers passing back and forth. The enemy on the eastern side of the empire has a name in the Behistun inscription, where a rebellion is attributed to Naram-Sin the Indian. Later Greek writers call this figure Enkiddu, and most scholars identify him as the ruler of the Gandhara region, corresponding exactly to the province of Gandhara in the list of the inscription. The second kind are the people who left words. Herodotus, in Books III.92 to III.102 of the Histories, supplements the account of the expedition to the Indus with the fighting against the Sattagydes and the Indians, and with the fact that only one city was taken. The same book records that Darius sent the Greek navigator Scylax with a party of scouts down the Indus, who returned to Egypt by the Red Sea after thirty months, leaving behind only fragments of his Periplus. Craftspersons left their traces as well: on the Behistun relief the king holds a bow in his left hand and raises his right, an attendant holds his spear, and nine bound captives lie at his feet; the reliefs of the Indian tribute-bearers on the Apadana staircase at Persepolis are the work of another set of hands. The third kind are the garrisons and officers who stayed where they were: the commander of the garrison in the city by the Indus, the local chiefs of Gandhara, and the village headmen of Gandhara, Sattagydia, Dadica and the Aparytae. The fourth kind are the later describers: Ctesias of Cnidus, who reported that the Persian king received rich gifts from the kings of India and saw Indian elephants and their mahouts demonstrate their strength at court, and Strabo, who in the fifteenth book of his Geography set out the distribution of the peoples along the Indus.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛是公元前九世紀亞述步兵的短柄長刃矛：木杆不長，前端裝鐵鏃，與弓和鐵器一起配給士兵。它的血脈經米底、巴比倫落到居魯士手上的波斯軍隊，終於成為阿契美尼德帝國的制式裝備。希羅多德在描述薛西斯大軍裡的波斯護盾兵時寫得很清楚：每人帶一張柳條編的圓盾、一支短矛、一張蘆葦弓、一個箭袋、一柄木柄短彎刀，外加一輛小車，車上裝著熟食、鋪蓋和一口小鍋。護盾兵正是阿契美尼德大軍的中線骨架，短矛用來頂住對方衝鋒、替身後的弓手騰出射擊空間，亞述矛的樣式在這裡幾乎原樣保留下來，只是矛頭的質地更精、包裹更緊。印度方面的步兵裝備，希羅多德在四世紀另有描述：蘆葦做的弓、蘆葦箭桿配鐵鏃、生皮繪彩的盾、木製劍身而尖端為鐵的短劍；健馱羅人與巴克特里亞人同列，備米底式頭巾、蘆葦弓與短矛。全軍還有馬車、馱馬、牛拉的輜重車，以及渡河用的舟船與架浮橋的木材。攻城器械在此役沒有留下記錄，因為健馱羅與薩塔吉達的抵抗以野戰與渡河戰為主；倒是後來阿契美尼德與印度人打交道時，印度的柚木、象牙與被稱道的黃金，成為宮殿與作坊的常備材料。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card is the short-shafted, long-bladed spear of the Assyrian infantry of the ninth century BC: a wooden staff of no great length with an iron head at the front, issued to the soldier together with a bow and other iron equipment. Its line of descent runs through Media and Babylonia into the Persian army that Cyrus inherited, and it finally became the standard equipment of the Achaemenid Empire. Herodotus describes the Persian shield-bearers in the army of Xerxes in plain terms: each man carried a wicker round shield, a short spear, a bow of cane, a quiver of arrows, and a short sword with a wooden hilt, and in addition a small cart holding cooked food, bedding and a little cauldron. The shield-bearers were the skeleton of the Achaemenid centre, and the short spear was what they used to hold off a charge and to open the shooting space for the archers behind them; the form of the Assyrian spear survived here almost unchanged, though the metal of the head was better and the binding tighter. On the Indian side, Herodotus gives a fourth-century description of the equipment of the foot: bows of cane, arrows of cane shafted with iron heads, shields of raw hide painted with figures, and short swords of wood with an iron point. The Gandharans are listed with the Bactrians, wearing a Median-style headdress and carrying a bow of cane and a short spear. The army also had chariots, pack mules, ox-drawn baggage waggons, the boats used to cross the river and the timber from which the pontoon was built. No siege engines are recorded for this campaign, because the resistance of Gandhara and Sattagydia took the form of field engagements and fighting at the crossings; what the Achaemenids did take from India in later times, however, were the teak, the ivory and the much-vaunted gold, which became standard material for palaces and workshops.
tactics: 從蘇薩與波斯波利斯出發的遠征靠御道網維持：命令與補給沿驛站接力，一份公文走完全程要數十天，因此東線作戰必須壓在有限的作戰季內完成。渡河是全役的關鍵。希臘方面的記述說河面以舟船架成浮橋，騎兵、車隊與步兵在短時間內一齊過岸，先鋒弓手與車隊在對岸掩護渡口，並不讓對手有機會在渡口前集結。渡過之後，阿契美尼德的陣形是標準配置：萬人護盾兵列在中軍最前，肩並肩持短矛構成盾牆；弓手在後方與兩翼成排齊射，壓制敵陣展開；車隊與騎兵在兩翼機動，尋找缺口；缺口一旦出現，國王與御前近衛便以車隊一次衝入，不給對手重整的時間。追擊與清剿緊接其後：希羅多德說薩塔吉達人只被攻下一座城市，其餘歸順。戰術的第二條線在海上：達里烏斯另派斯庫拉克斯沿印度河下行勘察航道，把陸軍的前進與海路的試探同步進行；後來他在紅海一端回到埃及，這條航線日後成為帝國把埃及與印度河連接起來的技術前提。
tacticsEn: The expedition that set out from Susa and Persepolis was sustained by the network of the Royal Road: orders and supply moved by relay from station to station, a despatch took weeks to travel the whole way, and for that reason the campaign in the east had to be compressed into the short season in which the roads were passable. The crossing of the river was the hinge of the whole operation. The Greek account says the surface of the river was bridged with boats, so that cavalry, wagons and infantry passed over in a short space of time, with the leading archers and the chariots covering the far bank and screening the crossing, and the enemy was given no chance to assemble in front of it. After the crossing the Achaemenid order of battle was the standard one: the ten thousand shield-bearers stood at the head of the centre, side by side with their short spears making a wall of shields; the archers fired in ranks from the rear and the flanks to deny the enemy room to deploy; the chariots and the cavalry manoeuvred on the wings in search of a gap; and the moment a gap appeared the king and his guard rode in with the chariots in a single stroke, giving the enemy no time to reform. The pursuit and the reduction of the country followed: Herodotus says the Sattagydes lost a single city and the rest came in. The second line of the operation lay on the water. Darius sent Scylax down the Indus to survey the course of the river, so that the advance of the land army and the probing of the sea route went forward together; he came back to Egypt at the Red Sea end of the voyage, and that line of exploration later became the technical precondition for joining Egypt to the Indus.
data: 可核對的數字分幾類。年表方面，中文的戰爭列表把此役繫於公元前五一八年；貝希斯敦銘文所列的二十三個屬地中已含健馱羅與薩塔吉達，一般據此推斷兩地在前五一八年前後落入帝國；達里烏斯即位於前五二二年，貝希斯敦銘文的刻製約在前五一〇年，而阿帕達納奠基金銀牌上的銘文約在前五一五年，宣稱疆域從信德到呂底亞，信德即興都什一帶的印度河谷。兵力方面，此役的總數沒有記載；唯一有固定數字的是護盾兵大隊的一萬人。希羅多德第三卷第八十九節給出的全軍總數（步兵約一百七十萬、騎兵約二十萬、戰車約一萬）屬於前四八〇年對希臘的遠征，比本役晚四十年，不能移用；同書第三卷第八十五節則說印度人在全軍的馬匹與騎兵中數量居前。稅收是最硬的數字：印度人為第二十行省，貢金三百六十優斐亞他蘭特，約合八千三百公斤金粉，約佔帝國總貢賦三成；第七行省由薩塔吉達、健馱羅、達迪卡與阿帕里塔合成，合計一百七十他蘭特。距離方面，蘇薩到印度河約二千五百至三千公里，波斯波利斯到傑赫勒姆河約一千六百公里。考古方面，普什卡拉瓦蒂在一九六二年出土阿契美尼德時期的建築，比爾丘（塔克西拉）在一九一三至一九三四年發掘出同期的堡壘與運河；喀布爾、普什卡拉瓦蒂與比爾丘三處錢幣窖藏出土大量阿契美尼德金幣與希臘錢幣。月份一欄並非文獻所載，是按渡河須避開夏季洪水的常規作戰季推填。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall into several classes. As to chronology, the Chinese list of battles ties this campaign to 518 BC. The twenty-three subject lands listed in the Behistun inscription already include Gandhara and Sattagydia, and it is generally inferred from this that both fell to the empire around 518 BC. Darius came to the throne in 522 BC, the Behistun inscription was carved around 510 BC, and the inscription on the gold and silver foundation tablets of the Apadana, dating from about 515 BC, declares the dominion to run from Sind to Lydia, Sind being the Indus valley around Hindush. As to numbers of men, the total for this campaign is not recorded; the only fixed figure is the ten thousand of the shield-bearer corps. The overall strength given by Herodotus at III.89, infantry of about 1.7 million, cavalry of about 200,000 and some 10,000 chariots, belongs to the expedition against Greece in 480 BC, forty years after this campaign, and cannot be carried across; at III.85 the same author says that the Indians furnished among the largest numbers of horses and riders in the army. Tribute is the hardest of the figures. The Indians formed the twentieth taxation district and paid 360 Euboean talents, about 8,300 kilograms of gold dust, roughly a third of all the tribute of the empire; the seventh district, made up of Sattagydia, Gandhara, the Dadicae and the Aparytae, paid 170 talents between them. As to distance, Susa to the Indus is about 2,500 to 3,000 kilometres, and Persepolis to the Jhelum about 1,600. As to archaeology, excavations at Pushkalavati in 1962 brought to light buildings of the Achaemenid period, and work at Bhir Mound at Taxila between 1913 and 1934 revealed fortifications and canals of the same date; the coin hoards of Kabul, Pushkalavati and Bhir Mound have yielded large numbers of Achaemenid gold darics and Greek coins. The month entered in this record is not given by any source; it follows the ordinary campaigning season, in which the river has to be crossed before the summer flood.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。最遠的一層是居魯士開的局：他生前已把帝國東界推到印度河西岸，健馱羅與薩塔吉達一帶只是勉強臣服，名義上的關係隨時會斷。第二層是達里烏斯自己的處境：他前五二二年靠十個部落首領與近衛殺死冒充斯美爾迪斯的祭司高米達而奪位，接著平定薩迦、巴比倫、埃利斯等地的反叛，軍隊與稅收都被西線吸住；只有把東線的邊界一次做定，帝國才算有完整的疆域。第三層是眼前的利益：印度河谷是帝國最肥沃、人口最多的地區，希羅多德說它貢賦最厚；此外還有柚木、象牙與被傳說為產量極大的黃金。第四層是路：從蘇薩到印度河的陸路長達數千公里，季節性洪水讓道路與河道年年都難通，達里烏斯因此另派斯庫拉克斯沿印度河勘察航道，並把埃及與印度河之間的紅海通道納入計畫。貝希斯敦銘文的敘事也透露了動機：國王以這些國家臣服於我的口吻，把東部戰役收進阿胡拉·馬茲達賜予疆域的框架，於是戰爭同時是一場對外戰役與一次帝國合法性的敘事。
causeEn: There were four layers of reason behind the fighting. The most distant is the situation Cyrus left behind: in his lifetime he had already pushed the eastern frontier of the empire to the western bank of the Indus, and Gandhara and Sattagydia were only nominally obedient, a relationship liable to break at any moment. The second layer is the condition of Darius himself. In 522 BC he had taken the throne by killing the magus Gaumata, who had impersonated Smerdis, with the help of ten tribal chiefs and his guard, and he then had to put down risings in Saka, Babylonia and elsewhere; the army and the revenue of the empire were all absorbed by the western front. Only by settling the eastern frontier once and for all would the empire possess a complete dominion. The third layer is the prize in plain view: the Indus valley is the most fertile and most populous region of the empire, and Herodotus says it paid the richest tribute; there were teak, ivory and the gold whose output was said to be enormous besides. The fourth layer is the road. The land route from Susa to the Indus ran for thousands of kilometres, and the seasonal floods made both road and river hard to use every year, so Darius sent Scylax down the Indus to survey the channel and brought the sea route between Egypt and the Indus into the plan. The narrative of the Behistun inscription also gives away the motive: with the words these countries are subject to me the king folded the eastern campaign into the frame of a dominion bestowed by Ahuramazda, so that the war was at once an expedition abroad and a narrative of imperial legitimacy.
impact: 第一，最直接的是版圖。健馱羅、薩塔吉達與興都什此後出現在達里烏斯之後每一位阿契美尼德君王的陵墓名單上，直到薛西斯三世為止；印度西北部被納入行省式帝國的治理，開了先例，後來的亞歷山大帝國、印歐-西徐人、安息與貴霜都沿用這套框架。第二是治理方式。這些印度行省並沒有常任總督，地方由被稱為副王的本地首領治理，向巴克特里亞與阿拉科西亞的總督匯報；打戳金銀錠與希臘錢幣同時在市面流通，阿契美尼德打戳幣被許多學者視為印度打戳幣的先驅。第三是朝貢與兵源。印度人自此成為帝國常備軍的固定部分，前四八〇年薛西斯入侵希臘時，印度部隊在塞莫斯利與普拉提亞作戰，是全軍主要兵種之一；波斯波利斯阿帕達納台階上的印度貢使浮雕，赤膊赤足、牽驢背負器皿，是這段關係最生動的物證。第四是代價：疆域越長，東線越難維持，前三八〇年前後控制已開始鬆動，直到亞歷山大於前三二六年在希德河畔作戰，阿契美尼德在印度河流域近兩百年的統治才真正結束。
impactEn: The first effect is territorial. Gandhara, Sattagydia and Hindush appear on the tomb lists of every Achaemenid king after Darius, down to Xerxes III; the north-west of India was brought under the government of a satrapial empire, which set the precedent later followed by the Macedonian kingdom, the Indo-Scythians, the Parthians and the Kushans. The second is the mode of government. These Indian provinces had no permanent satrap; the country was administered by local rulers called hyparchs, or vice-regents, who reported to the satraps of Bactria and Arachosia. Punch-marked gold and silver bars and Greek coinage circulated side by side, and the Achaemenid punch-marked coin is held by many numismatists to be the forerunner of the Indian punch-marked coin. The third is tribute and manning of the ranks. The Indians became a standing element of the imperial army, and when Xerxes invaded Greece in 480 BC the Indian troops fought at Thermopylae and at Plataea as one of the main nations of the host; the relief of the Indian tribute-bearers on the Apadana staircase at Persepolis, bare-chested and barefoot, driving a donkey and carrying jars on a yoke, is the most vivid material trace of the relationship. The fourth is the cost. The longer the dominion grew, the harder the eastern line was to hold; by about 380 BC the control was already loosening, and it was only when Alexander fought by the Hydaspes in 326 BC that the close of two centuries of Achaemenid rule in the Indus valley was complete.
result: 結果的骨架是清楚的，細節則幾乎全缺。達里烏斯渡過印度河，擊敗那拉姆辛一系的抵抗；希羅多德記薩塔吉達人只失一城而其餘歸順；貝希斯敦把疆界立在印度河畔，健馱羅與薩塔吉達列進屬地清單，興都什其後成為獨立的行省名目。勝負判定是波斯勝：抵抗者不是被消滅，而是被編入行省、課以貢賦、徵為兵源，並在河上留一個能監視下游的據點。留下來的史料極為簡陋：貝希斯敦只有概括的幾句，沒有戰場位置、沒有雙方兵員、沒有損耗數字；希羅多德的補充寫在兩百年後，並且夾雜了別的傳說；阿帕達納奠基牌與波斯波利斯浮雕只給出疆界與朝貢的樣子。換句話說，這是一場以行政化收尾的邊疆戰爭，帝國並沒有征服整個印度河流域，只把最上游的幾個地區變成收稅與徵兵的單位，並把自己的東界畫在一條會年年改道的大河上。
resultEn: The outline of the outcome is clear while almost all of the detail is missing. Darius crossed the Indus and broke the resistance of the line of Naram-Sin; Herodotus records that the Sattagydes lost a single city and that the rest submitted; Behistun sets the frontier at the banks of the Indus, lists Gandhara and Sattagydia among the subject lands, and Hindush afterwards becomes the name of a province in its own right. On the question of who won, the answer is Persia. The resistance was not wiped out but was enrolled into provinces, assessed for tribute, drawn on for soldiers, and left with a post on the river from which the lower course could be watched. The evidence that survives is very thin. Behistun has a few summary lines, with no position of battle, no numbers on either side and no figures for losses; the supplement of Herodotus was written two centuries later and mixes in other traditions; the Apadana foundation tablets and the reliefs of Persepolis give only the shape of the frontier and of the tribute. In short this was a frontier war closed by administration. The empire did not conquer the whole Indus valley; it turned the uppermost regions into units for the collection of taxes and the levying of men, and drew its eastern boundary along a river that changes its course year by year.
